authority: OpenSpec proposals; KBD legacy ledger not migrated

changes.title: Restore the declared build matrix and local-only testing policy
changes.scope: Fix the demonstrated missing SignalEnvelope subject and reconcile MSRV. Remove CI-reachable test execution while preserving local entry points; correct stale Dart-generator guidance to ADR-003.
checks: Default, dev-endpoints and shape-facade checks plus applicable Clippy, format and SDK typecheck succeed locally against recorded source hashes.

Inventory every workflow/Dagger call path: CI performs build/lint/typecheck/format/package only; each removed runtime gate has a documented local invocation and is exercised by its owning later change.

changes.title: Provide an isolated local integration runner
changes.scope: Create a namespaced composed fixture and mandatory-prerequisite runner with disposable credentials, deadlines, receipts and ownership-safe cleanup. Replace the mux outline with real publish/receive; reserve CDC semantics for c008.
checks: A real authenticated publish reaches a subscribed gateway client; disabling delivery makes that assertion fail before restoration passes.
Missing prerequisites, zero required scenarios and skipped required tests exit nonzero; cleanup touches only the run-owned containers/volumes/slots.

changes.title: Resolve release decisions and complete dependency qualification research
changes.scope: Resolve Q1–Q7 with provenance and research the named identity/policy, persistence/deployment, media/federation and platform backlog in bounded passes. Inventory source/package/image revisions and runtime profiles. Record Q8 separately; KBD migration is not part of this change. Research and decision facilitation may start immediately; unresolved Q1–Q7 block closure and dependent implementation, not the start of this change.
checks: An accepted release matrix names required profiles, clients, source schemas/keys/tenants, historical/delete semantics, scale/retention/RTO/RPO, ASO budgets and profile-specific authorization lifetime endpoints.

Pinned API, compatibility and maintenance/security evidence exists for each retained dependency; unsupported choices trigger a revised proposal, not invented feasibility. Reconcile Assess provenance finding through focused independent review.

changes.title: Make selected deployment profiles portable and truthful
changes.scope: Render supported full and restricted-shape profiles from pinned artifacts and explicit identity/media/secret inputs. Remove absolute developer paths and false-success health checks; reject endpoints outside profile authority.
checks: Clean local installation of each selected profile reaches semantic readiness with real dependency handshakes; missing issuer/keys/broker/auth authority fails visibly.

Pinned images, declared secret sources, exposed ports and feature flags match the profile; release artifacts contain no dev authorization bypass. Each profile declares TLS termination, certificate/key/trust sources and external/internal network boundaries; valid HTTPS succeeds, invalid or missing TLS inputs fail startup/readiness, and prohibited plaintext or backend-bypass access is denied.

changes.title: Enforce identity and authorization on selected exposed lanes
changes.scope: Verify real Gate credentials and current object authorization on generic streams, and preserve Gate/ASO fresh authority on restricted shape streams. Check expiry, rotation, revoked grants, cancellation and bypass paths.
checks: Real Gate-issued tokens allow only intended issuer/audience/tenant/subject and object; same-tenant unauthorized subjects, cross-tenant access, authority loss, key rotation and stale refill races are exercised locally.

ASO authoritative commit/expiry to last server-produced protected frame or cancellation preventing the next frame is at most 5000 ms, followed by new-request denial; direct Kratos revocation uses the documented observation/ASO-denial start. All other lanes meet the lifetime contract accepted in c003.

changes.title: Freeze the versioned watch and recovery contract
changes.scope: Specify a new versioned WatchEntityType contract, canonical typed payload/key mapping and compatibility with immutable v1. Separate source LSN/epoch, stable event identity, partition offset and client checkpoint; specify snapshot barrier, ordering, duplicates, retention, lag, cancellation and authorized deletes.
checks: Contract scenarios cover accepted schema/key/tenant shapes, transaction commit, snapshot-to-live races, restart/replay, old cursors, unauthorized history and deletion/projection; consumer acceptance is recorded before codegen.

Frozen proto/flint/v1 files remain byte-identical; new-version generation and old/new compatibility validation succeed. Semver impact on frf-domain/frf-ports and one-port adapter boundaries are documented.

changes.title: Expose durable broker positions and commit-controlled replay
changes.scope: Replace producer-local replay counters with the accepted broker position mapping. Configure explicit commit policy instead of polling-time defaults and prove exact pinned-fork seek/replay/ack semantics, stable producer identity and cancellation.
checks: Crash after poll but before durable consumer checkpoint replays the event; restart after acknowledgement respects defined cursor inclusivity and duplicate rules.

Producer restart does not reuse a replay position; independent consumers, partition boundaries, retention expiry and cancellation behave as the frozen contract requires. Record actual server durability/flush configuration.

changes.title: Deliver committed typed CDC changes without checkpoint gaps
changes.scope: Reuse the pinned WAL parser; implement validated catalog/replica-identity mapping, schema-qualified routing and supported typed values. Couple acknowledged WAL progress to durable committed publication, including decode/transaction failures.
checks: Real INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE and rollback/multi-row transactions exercise enrolled non-first/composite/non-UUID keys and accepted tenant modes; unsupported mappings fail enrollment, not silent delivery.

Crash between publication and LSN advancement permits defined deduplication without loss; poison rows, schema change, unchanged TOAST and missing old-key data cannot be skipped beneath an acknowledged checkpoint.

changes.title: Populate durable v1 entity reads and watches
changes.scope: Compose a durable entity projection and population/checkpoint seam following one-port-per-adapter. Establish snapshot-to-WAL catch-up and readiness so existing GetEntity/WatchEntity reflect production ingestion.
checks: A database commit reaches existing v1 GetEntity and WatchEntity through real adapters; snapshot overlap does not omit or duplicate state incorrectly.
Gateway/projector restart preserves state and cursor coherence; delete removes current state; v1 wire remains unchanged and required per-event object authorization is applied.

changes.title: Serve authorized resumable WatchEntityType streams
changes.scope: Implement the frozen type-watch use case and transport using durable broker delivery and projection semantics. Enforce subscribe-time/per-event authority, bounded buffers, explicit resync and teardown. Generate and export the frozen-version tonic Rust client from frf-proto, and compile the Forge-facing client surface here before c011; c012 owns separate non-Rust package generation.
checks: Two authorized subscribers receive committed changes of the enrolled type; other schemas/types/tenants and unauthorized same-tenant subjects receive no protected payload.
Snapshot/subscribe races, reconnect, expired cursor, slow-client lag, cancellation during awaited authorization and revocation meet the contract; resources return to baseline.

changes.title: Replace Forge's Fabric stub with safe GraphQL delivery
changes.scope: Finish the runnable SQL-write -> Fabric WatchEntityType -> authenticated Forge GraphQL-subscription path using the c010 tonic client and canonical payload mapping. Deliver RLS projection, safe delete/invalidation behavior and truncation reconstruction. Retain LISTEN as a selectable rollback source.
checks: A real SQL create/update/delete reaches an authenticated GraphQL subscription through Fabric with only permitted fields, including composite/key changes and truncated payload reconstruction.
Checkpoint reconnect, revocation, backend failure and LISTEN/Fabric rollback are explicit and do not silently lose updates or double-apply them.

changes.title: Deliver the runnable PGlite–Forge–Electric prototype loop
changes.owner: Forge + Fabric shape facade + PGlite/PEM adapter
changes.scope: Implement the complete online PGlite -> authenticated Forge -> PostgreSQL -> Electric/Fabric -> PGlite/PEM loop after c011 tasks 2–3. Defer all behavioral proof until c013 functionality is complete, then use one combined c011–c013 campaign.
checks: A create/update/delete initiated against PGlite reaches PostgreSQL through Forge and returns through Electric/Fabric to PGlite and PEM without manual refresh or direct database access.
A second authenticated client observes canonical state, tenant/field projection is enforced, and LISTEN remains a usable Forge GraphQL rollback source.

changes.title: Make PGlite outbound sync durable and restart-safe
changes.owner: PGlite/PEM sync transport + Forge mutation API
changes.scope: After c012 tasks 2–3 are functional, add a durable PGlite outbox, stable mutation identity, retry/replay and canonical reconciliation. Defer behavioral proof to the combined c011–c013 campaign.
checks: An offline mutation survives client restart, submits after reconnect and converges through canonical Electric/Fabric state in PGlite and PEM.
Retries do not duplicate database effects; rejection/conflict is visible and recoverable; two clients converge while tenant isolation remains enforced.

changes.title: Diagnose and reduce the existing ASO replica memory cost
changes.scope: Reconcile current source with mounted receipts and profile the existing 16203-row workload. Apply measured, bounded memory corrections while preserving SQL/checkpoint atomicity, owner fencing and the experimental gate.
checks: Same-fixture browser campaign measures incremental RSS at or below 536870912 bytes and heap at or below 268435456 bytes, unless c003 records an explicit operator-approved replacement contract.

Worker/DB/graph-copy and cold-fold allocations explain the result; passing behavior survives optimization. If one bounded session cannot close the gate, record findings and split remaining implementation before continuing; do not close this change on diagnosis alone. Inspect the owning ASO repository rules before edits; any modified file must be at most 500 lines, splitting replica-runtime.ts if that file is touched and preserving its owner fences. Untouched oversized files remain explicitly tracked.

changes.title: Qualify the protected shape-to-SQL-to-PEM path
changes.scope: Prove current-source protected replication using the existing shape feed and materializer, independently of generic entity watching. Cover every selected browser/native topology and approved schema/egress boundary.
checks: Crash before SQL checkpoint rolls back rows/checkpoints; crash after SQL commit before PEM publication recovers coherently only after current authorization. Logout/practice switch fences stale owners and clears the old graph.

Interrupted shape bodies, expiry/refetch, revocation timing, direct-backend isolation and forbidden/local-only field egress pass for each selected topology; no competing generic-watch writer handles the same clinical rows. Inspect the owning ASO repository rules before edits; any modified file must be at most 500 lines, splitting replica-runtime.ts if that file is touched and preserving its owner fences. Untouched oversized files remain explicitly tracked.

changes.title: Qualify hosted media on its selected profile
changes.scope: Reuse researched LiveKit integration; prove real two-participant decoded audio/video and grant lifetime on the selected server version. Qualify relay only if advertised.
checks: Two clients show progressing decoded audio/video across late join and reconnect; wrong room/tenant/subject is denied and revoked participants stop under the accepted lifetime contract.
Any advertised cross-node relay passes a two-gateway campaign; absent configurations fail visibly. Local protocol fixtures alone cannot certify an untested production service version.

changes.title: Qualify Matrix directions and restart cursors
changes.scope: Reuse actual Matrix sync/send code. Repair demonstrated direction/cursor/echo defects and stale stub logs; qualify the accepted Tuwunel/Matrix version.
checks: Inbound and outbound events reach intended rooms/channels after bridge restart with bounded deduplication and durable cursor continuity.
Echo-loop suppression, cross-tenant denial, target outage and unconfigured direction errors are asserted against the actual selected local server version.

changes.title: Qualify ATProto ingestion and outbound recovery
changes.scope: Reuse existing firehose and configured outbound implementations. Prove stable cursor/channel identity, authorization and retry behavior against selected Tranquil/PDS versions.
checks: Supported directions resume after disconnect/process restart without missed acknowledged events or unbounded duplication.

Outbound retries, self-echo, tenant/channel routing and unavailable/unconfigured targets have explicit assertions; faithful protocol mocks are labeled and cannot substitute for target-version qualification.

changes.title: Close sovereign media decode and protected fan-out
changes.scope: Reproduce the zero-decoded-frame failure in a locally controlled Linux ICE/TURN topology. Trace room/track/keyframe routing, apply the smallest demonstrated correction and prove room-scoped protected egress.
checks: Repeated two-peer campaigns show increasing receiver framesDecoded plus audio progress, including late join/reconnect and multiple rooms; ICE/RTP alone is insufficient.
Revocation/expiry removes protected fan-out within c003's accepted bound; wrong-room/tenant traffic is denied and task/socket counts return to baseline. Keep production mode gated until proof.

changes.title: Deliver the accepted admin authentication profile
changes.scope: Implement only the admin profile accepted in c003: either a deliberately restricted operator tool or the separately accepted interactive login design. Reuse the actual Gate/IdP surface without assuming an unrelated identity provider.
checks: Selected admin login/token entry, expiry, logout and unauthorized access behavior work against real local identity services.
Interactive-login claims require the actual redirect/session flow; a documented operator-only profile is never reported as delivered interactive login.

changes.title: Qualify required native and generated SDK transports
changes.scope: Expand the working c012-c013 browser/Node transport into selected native/generated SDK surfaces using pinned or explicitly superseded ADR-003 tooling; qualify real install/runtime/device behavior.
checks: Each required platform installs the packaged artifact and performs authenticated publish/watch/reconnect; supported offline outbox behavior survives process replacement.
Dart async remains blocked until a real transport proof passes; unsupported platforms remain excluded with explicit reasons, without claiming full phase closure or parity.

changes.title: Qualify capacity, recovery and rotation per profile
changes.scope: Execute load and failure campaigns at accepted profile targets; cover broker/WAL/checkpoint lag, backup/restore, rolling replacement, secrets/certificate rotation, drains and no-progress alerts. Final qualification cannot close before every selected profile implementation and client surface is complete; early diagnostic campaigns are non-final.
checks: Local campaigns meet accepted subscription/change-rate/latency/retention/RTO/RPO targets with explicit resource allocation, no required skips and recorded recovery positions.

Restoration and credential/certificate rotation preserve required authorization and durable state; bounded backpressure/cancellation and alerts prevent false-ready/no-progress operation. Repeat affected receipts after consumer or profile changes.

changes.title: Produce source-bound release verdicts for each agreed profile
changes.scope: Re-audit effective source/configuration, verify all selected profile receipts and publish a dated local GO/NO-GO matrix. Reconcile capability, rollout/rollback and support documentation; retain separate phase, certification and publication statuses.
checks: Every selected profile has exact repository/diff/lockfile/package/image/config/topology fingerprints, commands, timestamps, exits, scenario counts and artifact hashes; critical/high findings are resolved by an independent reviewer.

A narrower profile may receive a scoped interim verdict while other capabilities remain blocked; c023 and the whole phase cannot close until all agreed phase goals are satisfied or the operator explicitly accepts scope reduction. No registry publication/deployment is inferred.
